summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour provides detailed instruction on the proper form and etiquette of prayer (salah), specifically focusing on the opening supplications (duas) and the recitation of Surah Al-Fatihah. He explains that duas at specific positions in prayer must be based on the Prophet's example rather than personal innovation, and discusses how the Prophet would recite the opening dua silently most of the time while beginning Surah Al-Fatihah audibly. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes the correct timing and manner of saying "Ameen" after the imam completes Surah Al-Fatihah, highlighting common mistakes such as starting before the imam, saying it silently in congregational prayer, or continuing after others have finished. He concludes by explaining that the purpose of unified congregation prayer is to synchronize faith and create harmony, using the analogy of dominoes to illustrate how individual discord disrupts the collective spiritual benefit.
